treatment_plan.definitive: *28*38 It is recommended to extract the tooth. Inform the patient of the related risks and complications during the tooth extraction, as well as the related costs. The patient expresses his understanding and willingness to accept the treatment.
treatment_plan.notes: 1. You can eat and drink immediately after resin filling; 2. If you have sensitivity to hot and cold stimuli or pain when biting something after filling, you need to contact the attending doctor for follow-up treatment; 3. Children's dentistry is special, and children cry and are uncooperative. Sometimes, the filling may fall off, and the resin filling can be filled once for free within half a year (except for secondary caries or tooth trauma and fracture, etc.); 4. Regular re-examination every 3-6 months, and follow-up for discomfort.
